parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: There are two isomeric complexes with the formula $\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}_2$, one of which is an anti-cancer drug.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
Draw diagrams to show the three-dimensional structures of the two isomers.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Comment on the polarity of the two isomers of $\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}_2$. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.stem:
Oxaloplatin is another successful anti-cancer drug in which the stereochemistry around the platinum atom is the same as that in $\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}_2$.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}
parts.text: Explain why there are no isomers of oxaloplatin.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Only one structure of the complex $[\text{Ni}(\text{R}_3\text{P})_2\text{Cl}_2]$ is known. ($\text{R} = \text{CH}_3$, $\text{R}_3\text{P}$ is a monodentate ligand)

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: What does this indicate about the stereochemistry around the nickel atom?

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Draw a three-dimensional diagram showing the structure of this complex.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}
